License text: COPYING from the exact unifont-16.0.04.tar.gz release, retrieved
from https://unifoundry.com/pub/unifont/unifont-16.0.04/ on 2026-10-19.
The bundled source is used by tools/rebuild_cjk16.py to restore complete CJK
bitmaps. The previous asset shifted glyph rows up by one and lost row zero.
The binary record count, codepoints and non-CJK glyphs remain unchanged.
